Nine functions and methods in `django/` call `constant_time_compare` directly. I confirmed this two ways: the code index said its list of callers was complete, and a plain text search of `django/` found the same 10 call sites. All of them use the name as imported; none rename it on import.

- `django/contrib/auth/__init__.py`: `login` (line 117) and `get_user` (lines 224 and 232)
- `django/contrib/auth/hashers.py`: `verify` in `PBKDF2PasswordHasher` (344), `BCryptSHA256PasswordHasher` (527), `ScryptPasswordHasher` (622) and `MD5PasswordHasher` (673)
- `django/contrib/auth/tokens.py`: `PasswordResetTokenGenerator.check_token` (line 70)
- `django/core/signing.py`: `Signer.unsign` (line 211)
- `django/middleware/csrf.py`: `_does_token_match` (line 157)
